note: The LENGTH of `clients` is the client count (DECISIONS 4, BUILD_PLAN 9.1). Raising 16 to 24 is adding eight rows here and re-running the generator. Nothing in js/ may contain the literal 16.

consumer_notes.video_element: <video muted playsinline webkit-playsinline autoplay loop preload="none" disablepictureinpicture poster="assets/clients/<id>.jpg">
consumer_notes.playsinline: REQUIRED. Without playsinline (and legacy webkit-playsinline) iOS Safari opens the native fullscreen player and ejects the player out of the game.
consumer_notes.muted: REQUIRED. Without it iOS refuses to autoplay without a gesture. The files carry no audio track at all, so this costs nothing.
consumer_notes.loop: REQUIRED and sufficient. The forward+reverse ping-pong is baked into the mp4 with no duplicated frame at the turn or at the wrap. Do NOT add any JS seek/playbackRate loop logic; it can only make this worse.
consumer_notes.preload: preload="none", and set src ONLY when the docking panel opens for that client. The job board must fetch zero .mp4.
consumer_notes.still_loading: The 384 still is ; the job board list uses ONLY the 96 thumb.
consumer_notes.play_failure: video.play() returns a promise that legitimately rejects (low power mode, gesture policy). Catch it and fall back to the still-with-shimmer path; never throw, never log an error, never leave a black rectangle.
consumer_notes.absence: Any of the three files may 404. Video missing -> still with scanline shimmer and no <video> at all. Still missing too -> generated placeholder (hex silhouette in the zone tint plus initials). The game must be fully playable with assets/clients/ deleted.
consumer_notes.tint: `tint_hex` is the client's district neon key colour and is the colour the portrait was actually lit with. Accent the panel with it and the portrait will agree.

clients.name: Mara Vells
clients.look: shaved sides, oil-stained collar, brass ear cuff
clients.light: hard cyan key from the left, cold rim on the right jaw
clients.backdrop: rain-streaked window, distant sign glow far out of focus

clients.name: Ozren Kalb
clients.build: heavyset and jowled, olive-skinned Balkan dock foreman
clients.look: reflective harness over a padded jacket, grey stubble, cracked datapad clipped at the chest
clients.line: Pad four. Don't scuff the crate.
clients.framing: chest-up, slight low angle looking up at him, 35mm
clients.light: amber sodium floodlight from high right, weak cyan bounce on the left shoulder
clients.backdrop: open cargo dock at night, haze, a floodlight blown out to a soft disc

clients.name: Sister Anais Wren
clients.build: gaunt and ascetic, very dark skin
clients.look: white hood, ceramic collar, a single lens clipped over the left eye
clients.line: The manifest is sealed. So are you.
clients.framing: head-and-shoulders, subject off-centre left with negative space to the right, 85mm
clients.light: flat pale ice-blue key straight on, almost no fill, black falloff behind the hood
clients.backdrop: black archive corridor, one distant vertical strip light

clients.name: Rat Kestin
clients.look: hood up, taped knuckles, cheap chrome jaw plate catching the light
clients.framing: tight close-up, face filling the frame, slightly off-axis, 50mm
clients.light: red neon key from low right, a thin cyan rim tracing the hood
clients.backdrop: alley wall, wet brick, red sign bleeding out of focus

clients.name: Yui Sorel
clients.look: steam-fogged glasses, cook's apron, hair tied back with a wire
clients.light: magenta lantern key from the right, warm amber underlight from a hot plate below
clients.backdrop: steam, hanging paper lanterns thrown far out of focus

clients.name: Deacon Ilo
clients.build: broad and still, dark-skinned West African
clients.look: shaved head, surgical collar, a jade indicator light on a chest rig
clients.line: Blood plasma. Keep it cold and keep it level.
clients.light: jade green key from directly below the chin, faint white rim above
clients.backdrop: dark ward, a bank of small monitor lights far behind

clients.name: Aurelia Vance
clients.look: tailored charcoal collar, one mirrored contact lens, precise silver bob
clients.line: Discretion is the larger half of the fee.
clients.framing: head-and-shoulders, centred, very shallow depth of field, 85mm
clients.light: cold white key from hard left, a single cyan specular in the mirrored lens
clients.backdrop: black glass boardroom, city lights reflected as tiny points

clients.name: Tovar Hask
clients.build: gaunt and weather-beaten, deeply lined ruddy face
clients.look: waterproof hood, rebreather slung at the neck, green algae stains on the shoulder
clients.line: Water's up again. Come in high.
clients.framing: chest-up, three-quarter turn, looking away from camera, 35mm
clients.light: sickly green channel light from behind and left, a weak amber key on the near cheek
clients.backdrop: flooded canal at night, green marker lights receding into fog

clients.name: Nix Corbel
clients.look: buzzcut, headset with a boom mic, cyan trace tattoos at the temple
clients.line: Two drops, same tower. You're welcome.
clients.framing: close-up, slight high angle, subject off-centre right, 50mm
clients.light: cyan key from a monitor directly in front, screen flicker on the face, no rim
clients.backdrop: dispatch booth, racks of small indicator lights out of focus

clients.name: Halvard Pike
clients.look: wool cap, jeweller's loupe pushed up on the forehead, fingerless gloves
clients.line: I never asked where it came from. Neither did you.
clients.framing: head-and-shoulders, three-quarter turn, leaning into frame, 50mm
clients.light: warm amber desk lamp from low left, deep shadow filling the right of the face
clients.backdrop: cluttered shop counter, brass and glass catching tiny highlights

clients.name: Ines Marrow
clients.look: high collar zipped to the chin, hairline scar through one eyebrow, condensation on the lens between you
clients.line: No names on this one. Not even mine.
clients.framing: tight close-up, eyes on the upper third, shot through glass, 85mm
clients.light: pale ice-blue key from hard right, cyan rim from behind, near-black on the left half
clients.backdrop: fogged glass with rain running down it, blurred street light beyond

clients.name: Brack Osun
clients.look: welding goggles pushed up on the forehead, soot-streaked face, scorched collar
clients.line: It's heavy. Don't be clever with it.
clients.light: red furnace glow from below, hard white spark-light flaring from the left
clients.backdrop: rig deck at night, orange sparks falling far behind, heavy haze

clients.name: Momo Ferrer
clients.look: glitter under the eyes, magenta undercut, oversized fur collar
clients.line: Doors in an hour. The ice is not optional.
clients.light: magenta key from the right and a violet kicker from the left, both hard, no fill
clients.backdrop: club entrance, magenta strip lights streaking out of focus

clients.name: Elder Tam Osei
clients.look: woven shawl over the shoulders, soil under the nails, wire-rim glasses
clients.line: Slow hands. Everything in that box is alive.
clients.light: jade green grow-light from above and behind, leaf shadows across the face, faint warm fill
clients.backdrop: dark growhouse, rows of green light receding, leaves out of focus

clients.name: Auditor Kell
clients.look: no glasses, deep-set tired eyes, grey suit buttoned to the throat, a clip badge with no name on it
clients.line: Sign at the pad. Not before. Not after.
clients.framing: head-and-shoulders, dead centre, flat and unflattering, 50mm
clients.light: hard overhead white panel light with a weak cyan fill lifting the eyes, one thin cyan rim
clients.backdrop: empty office corridor at night, one distant ceiling panel lit

clients.name: Sable Quint
clients.build: rangy, salt-worn, mixed-race with sun-damaged skin
clients.look: wet braids, tarpaulin coat with the collar up, a wide crooked grin
clients.line: If it floats, it was never mine.
clients.framing: chest-up, off-centre right, turned back over the shoulder toward camera, 35mm
clients.light: green deck light from behind and below, thin amber key raking the near cheek
clients.backdrop: open water at night, green channel markers, rain streaking through the light
